div.div: Postponed and Cancelled leave the installed version untouched. Failed with “needs attention” (no previous binary, or the roll-back itself failed) leaves the runner stopped and tells the user. Timeouts are the UpdateTimeouts defaults: drain 3 h, stop 2 min, confirm 5 min.
